notes.title: HYNPYTOL 1.5 Update: Dive deep into HYNPYTOL’s world with the Immunopedia!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
To celebrate HYNPYTOL's release on Nintendo Switch, the major 1.5 patch has been implemented!

Various content, features, and quality-of-life improvements have been added. Additionally, the trailer has been updated!
Here are the details:

[list]
[*] The ‘Immunopedia’ has been newly added. Discover the characteristics and stories of various immune friends!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/30f0f2879ac8b4cc839783a26d4d4aa7580b8473.png[/img]
[*] New visual effects have been added. Experience the displays of old-school gaming consoles and CRT monitors!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/58a217e76b987fbc0c30e8460bc326675035b7d2.gif[/img]
[*] To commemorate the Nintendo Switch release, new borders have been added. They are the foundation upon which HYNPYTOL stands.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/fd0ca3342c5511a3951fdd12093cc2b94cfebb59.jpg[/img]
[*] Cute updates have been made to the ‘GameKid’ border. Check out the Easter Egg achievements!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/a78e96e2c4c23c78d683b740a20a95652de12b6d.png[/img]
[*] The structure of the Thymus has been remade. Did you know the T in T-cells stands for Thymus? They're named for their final tests in the thymus!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/52f0134aa8fa6816a052623a8b5f89a9b81f7790.png[/img]
[*] A control helper popup now appears in the Bone Marrow! No more confusion… hopefully?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/561b3f275a5b784da01114d0ac05aab00547bd3a.png[/img]
[*] The structure of the Memory Center has been remade. It’s as intricate as its name suggests.
[*] Adorable name tags now appear in dialogue! No more guessing who’s who.
[*] A ‘Skip Dialogue’ option has been added for multiple playthroughs. Just high-five your way through!
[*] Extras have been added to the pause screen and title menu. Check out the codex and credits mid-game!
[*] A special new song has been added exclusively for the Immunopedia! Rumor has it there are different versions depending on the situation...
[*] The entrance design of the Filter Region has been tweaked. They say the cells have added festive headgear for their sports day!
[*] The Paradise of the Surface design has been altered. Enjoy a fireworks show over the nighttime sea!
[*] Controller support now includes satisfying vibrations. Feel the thrill in your hands!
[*] The visibility of the Filter Region has been improved.
[*] The structure of the Lymph Nodes has been refined.
[*] Some Time Attack map structures have been improved.
[*] The difficulty and level design of the Infected Cell area have been slightly adjusted.
[*] Visuals for certain maps have been enhanced.
[*] Starry letterboxes now appear in fullscreen mode.
[*] The Korean font has been updated.
[*] The issue where Chinese did not function properly in the initial language selection screen has been fixed.
[*] Certain dialogue misprints in German have been corrected.
[*] The problem where Workshop uploads were possible without clearing the levels has been resolved.
[*] Certain UI misalignments in the Level Editor have been fixed.
[*] The Level Editor now supports controller input.
[*] ESC not functioning in certain situations in the Level Editor has been resolved.
[*] The inability to input a title after saving in the Level Editor has been fixed.
[/list]

This major update for HYNPYTOL will (probably) be its last.
Thank you so much for joining us on this long journey through the immune system!
We couldn’t have come this far without you.
We hope this patch brings the world of HYNPYTOL closer to your hearts.
Please help spread the word so more people can explore the immune system!

notes.title: HYNPYTOL 1.4 Update : Build Your Own Immune System with the New Level Editor!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

The fourth major update for HYNPYTOL, the 1.4 update, is now live!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44481491/438b2b394ba45d8ebd0aca35d26fd973d8d6c3af.jpg[/img]

We're thrilled to announce the addition of a [b]Level Editor[/b] to HYNPYTOL! You can now construct your own immune systems and share them with others on the [b]Steam Workshop.[/b]

This update also includes various fixes, improvements, and a new language addition. Here are the details:

[list]
[*] Level Editor Added: Create and share your own immune systems on the Workshop! From brain-teasing puzzles to adorable pixel art, the possibilities are endless and entirely up to you.
[*] German Language Support: HYNPYTOL is now available in German! Ich drück dir die Daumen!
[*] Improved Controller Responsiveness: Enhanced controls for a smoother gameplay experience.
[*] Trigger Activation Issue Fixed: Resolved an issue where triggers would activate unintentionally.
[*] Dialogue Consistency Fixed: Fixed a problem where dialogue on the ground did not change after certain conditions were met.
[*] Title Music Playback Fixed: Resolved an issue where the title music wouldn’t play after viewing certain endings.
[*] Text Size Issue Fixed: Fixed a bug where the font size appeared larger when explaining controller operations.
[*] Time Count Issue Fixed: Resolved an issue where the time count in the main profile increased when playing from the level select.
[*] Map Improvement: Improved a section of the "Technicolor from Outer Space" map to match the intended gameplay experience.
[*] Map Transition Issue Fixed: Fixed an issue where players could move to the next map without completing the current one.
[*] Steam Deck Video Playback Fixed: Resolved an issue where the ending credits video didn’t play correctly on the Steam Deck.
[*] New T-Cell Dream Sequence: After the T-Cell falls asleep for the first time, it will experience a new dream.
[*] Additional Borders: A few new border types have been added.
[*] Chinese Font Update: Updated the Chinese font for better readability.
[*] Two New Achievements: Added two new achievements for players to unlock.
[*] New Hidden Easter Egg: A hidden Easter egg has been added. What did the original HYNPYTOL look like? [i]Hint: UFO[/i]
[/list]

To celebrate the Level Editor update, base0 has created [b]18 special bonus levels[/b]!
You can play them by subscribing to the entire collection [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3301290781]here[/url].

We also invite you to participate in the Workshop Level Creation Event, starting tomorrow on our official account. Stay tuned!

HYNPYTOL's third major update, 1.3 update applied!
In addition, we have produced a new trailer for HYNPYTOL, which has changed and developed a lot so far.

[*] Some lines have been changed.
[*] The order of some levels has been changed.
[*] Below the temple of eruption, there is a rumor that there is an underground prison.
[*] Chinese opening resource changed.
